serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: This thing seems much higher when we are inside the cabin.
Bot: This ferris wheel is only 421 feet high. The highest one in the world is almost double that.
You: That’s crazy, a lot of thought had to be put into making something like that. 
Bot: We will soon be at the top!
Bot: Wow…{{wi}} The view is amazing. All the lights of this amusement park are sparkling like little jewels from here.
Bot: Even at night the whole area is nicely lit.
You: This perspective makes it seem like this megacity isn’t as bad as it is.
